founder_capability.rationale: Alice has 8 years enterprise software experience at Salesforce, led 3 product launches with strong execution. First-time founder is minor risk but mitigated by technical depth and execution bias.

problem_fit.rationale: All 18 customer interviews confirmed strong pain point. Finance teams spend 4-10 hours/week on manual data sync. Willingness to pay of $5-10K/month per customer is solid. Problem validated and urgent.
data_points: 4-10 hours per week current manual work

tam_analysis.rationale: Large market with $850M TAM in enterprise integration. Serviceable market of $150M in mid-market finance segment is addressable. 15% CAGR shows strong growth trajectory. Conservative estimate given adjacent market size.
data_points: Mid-market segment growing faster than enterprise

feasibility.rationale: MVP technically feasible with clear architecture (REST APIs + webhooks). 8-month timeline with 4 engineers is reasonable. Data validation and customer onboarding are identified risks but not showstoppers.
data_points: REST API + webhook architecture is proven approach
8-month MVP timeline with 4-person team is reasonable

overall_rationale: CloudSync demonstrates strong fundamentals across all screening criteria. Founder (Alice) has deep enterprise software experience with proven execution track record. Problem is well-validated through 18 customer interviews with quantified pain. Market size is substantial ($850M TAM, $150M serviceable). MVP is technically feasible with reasonable timeline and team size. All gates cleared. Recommend advancement to QUALIFIED stage and structured business planning.
confidence_rationale: High confidence due to comprehensive customer validation (18 interviews), clear technical approach, and experienced founder. Minor uncertainty on founder capability as first-time founder, but mitigated by deep technical background and execution bias. TAM estimate is conservative but well-supported.
key_strengths: Experienced technical founder with proven execution track record at enterprise scale
Strong problem validation via 18 customer interviews with consistent feedback
Large addressable market with double-digit growth rate
Clear technical architecture with proven approach
key_weaknesses: First-time founder with no prior startup experience (mitigated by depth of expertise)

If finances permit, pairing with experienced COO/operator would be valuable.
